summary: This note describes the 1961 song "Hey! Baby", written by Margaret Cobb and Bruce Channel and recorded by Channel. It was first released on the local Fort Worth, Texas label LeCam Records and later distributed nationally through Smash Records. The song reached number one on the Billboard Hot 100 for three weeks beginning the week ending March 10, 1962.
one_line: "Hey! Baby" is a 1961 song by Bruce Channel that topped the Billboard Hot 100 for three weeks in 1962.
key_facts: "Hey! Baby" is a song written by Margaret Cobb and Bruce Channel.
The song was first released on LeCam Records, a local Fort Worth, Texas label.
After the song hit, it was released on Smash Records for national distribution.
Bruce Channel co-produced "Hey! Baby" with Major Bill Smith, owner of LeCam.
The song was released on Mercury Records' Smash label.
"Hey! Baby" reached number one on the Billboard Hot 100.
The song spent three weeks at number one on the Billboard Hot 100.
The three-week run at number one started the week ending March 10, 1962.
